assumptions: benchmarkAnnualLoadedCostPerHire is a market benchmark, not an agreed offer figure; actual loaded cost varies by role and seniority.
Runway is deliberately the zero-revenue stress case, not a going-concern projection.
Operating costs are assumed flat month over month for this reporting period.
knownGaps: No per-department cost allocation is available; operating costs are only broken down by category.
No individual compensation records are held in this dataset; salary data is owned by HR systems outside Finance's authorised scope.
No committed new-revenue pipeline is modelled, so growth is a projection rather than contracted revenue.
